item.title: 322— When God Doesn't Heal: Losing My Wife to Cancer
item.description:
This week, we sit down with Caleb to hear the story of losing his wife, Morgan, to cancer after years of praying for healing. We talk about unanswered prayers, walking through grief, and learning to trust God's goodness when life doesn't turn out the way we hoped.
